body_en:
My Salutations to all Pious Souls....

During the recently concluded Guru-Poornima festival, the Guru-energies have distributed the 'newly created subtle body photo as prasad' (blessings) to everyone.

Thousands of sadhaks in India and abroad are now asking for this same photo, and the Gurutattva team also desires that sadhaks all over the world should receive the same photo as soon as possible; to facilitate that objective they have created a 'link' to download the subtle body photo, so that the sadhaks can obtain the same at the earliest.

Secondly, there shouldn't be any need to send it by courier and the purity of the photo should also be maintained since it is the 'prasad' (blessing) distributed by the Guru-energies during the Guru-poornima festival, and prasad is always free.  So, now the sadhaks can download the photo and print the same in the 'size' they desire as per their feelings.

It is my desire that you should place a red coloured paper behind the photo and then mount the photo in a broad golden coloured frame. In the past 20 years, the receiving capacity of the sadhaks to receive (energy) from the Guru-energies too has increased, and the collectivity too is now of millions of sadhaks. This is everyone's Anubhuti, and all of you will also get this Anubhuti with this divine subtle body photo.

Lots of blessings to all of you.

Your own
Baba Swami
22|7|2022

Note: The link has been provided along with this letter.
https://gurutattva.org/subtle-body-photos/
